name: Rohit Sharma
pain: Pipeline bahut unpredictable hai. Kuch months 10L, kuch months 2L. No system for lead qualification. Demos book hote hain but close nahi hote. Long sales cycles - 60-90 days average.
prior_experience: Yes - tried 2 coaches, didn't work. Strategy was good but execution gap thi.
outcome: If pipeline becomes predictable - 5-7L/month consistent - I can hire, scale team, stop firefighting. Freedom chahiye daily ops se.

answers.q_pain_1: Pipeline completely unpredictable. Referrals pe depend kar rahe hain. No inbound system.
answers.q_fit_3: Predictable pipeline system chahiye. Automation + my expertise = scale.

name: Priya Mehta
pain: Too many tire-kickers. Free discovery calls book hote hain but convert nahi. Premium packages (₹50k+) sell mushkil. Referrals se 1-2 clients milte per month but inconsistent.
prior_experience: No - first time hiring external help
decision_maker: Yes - but will discuss with partner/spouse
outcome: If I can consistently get 3-4 premium clients/month at ₹50k+, that's ₹2L/month predictable. Can then build team, create group programs.

answers.q_pain_2: Sirf cheap clients milte. Premium positioning nahi ban pa rahi. People say 'pehle free session do'.
answers.q_fit_1: Yes - but will discuss with partner/spouse
answers.q_fit_3: Premium client acquisition system. Gate to filter, drip to pre-sell, call to close.

name: Vikram Singh
pain: Scaling problem. We can deliver but client acquisition manual hai. Depends on my network. Want to build predictable inbound engine. Current CAC too high (₹80k per client).
prior_experience: Yes - worked well with previous consultant
decision_maker: Yes - but will discuss with co-founder
outcome: If CAC drops to ₹30-40k and pipeline becomes predictable (8-10 qualified leads/month), we can 2x revenue without hiring more salespeople.

answers.q_pain_1: CAC high hai. Sales cycle long. Want inbound system that pre-qualifies + pre-sells.
answers.q_fit_1: Yes - but will discuss with partner/spouse
answers.q_fit_3: Inbound engine. Automated qualification. Pre-sell before call. Lower CAC, higher close rate.

name: Neha Gupta
pain: Just starting. Have expertise but no clients. Social media se engagement hai but sales nahi. Don't know how to position premium packages. Confused about pricing.
outcome: If I can get even 2-3 paying clients at ₹20-30k, that validates the business. Then I can invest more in scaling.

answers.q_pain_2: No clients yet. Social media pe content post karti but DMs mein sirf 'price kya hai' aata.
answers.q_fit_3: Kuch toh system chahiye client acquisition ka. Abhi completely lost feel ho raha.

name: Arun Patel
pain: Clients expect instant results. Retention issue - after 3 months drop-off. Want to build long-term retainer model. Currently one-off projects only.
prior_experience: Yes - tried agency, didn't work. They brought leads but quality low.
outcome: If I can convert model to retainer (6-12 month contracts) instead of one-off projects, revenue predictable ho jayegi. LTV increase, retention increase.

answers.q_pain_1: One-off projects. No retainer model. Clients 3 months mein churn. Want long-term relationships.
answers.q_fit_3: Retainer model. Long-term clients. Predictable MRR. Retention system.
